lines.beaver: 오늘 모임에 처음 오셨죠? 어떤 취미가 있으세요?
lines.beaver_en: Is this your first time at our meeting? What's your hobby?
lines.beaver_roman: oneul moime cheoeum osyeotjyo? eotteon chwimiga isseuseyo?
lines.learner: 저는 시 낭송을 해요. 벌써 십 년째예요.
lines.en: I do poetry recitation. It's already been ten years.
lines.roman: jeoneun si nangsongeul haeyo. beolsseo sim nyeonjjaeyeyo.

lines.beaver: 시 낭송이요? 혹시 시도 직접 쓰세요?
lines.beaver_en: Poetry recitation? Do you also write poems yourself?
lines.beaver_roman: si nangsongiyo? hoksi sido jikjeop sseuseyo?
lines.learner: 네, 작년에 제 첫 시집을 냈어요.
lines.en: Yes, I published my first poetry collection last year.
lines.roman: ne, jangnyeone je cheot sijibeul naesseoyo.

lines.beaver: 와, 대단하시네요! 어떤 시들이 실려 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: Wow, that's amazing! What poems are in it?
lines.beaver_roman: wa, daedanhasineyo! eotteon sideuri sillyeo isseoyo?
lines.learner: 캠프 이야기예요. 천막에서 쓴 시가 많아요.
lines.en: It's about camping. Many poems were written in a tent.
lines.roman: kaempeu iyagiyeyo. cheonmageseo sseun siga manayo.

lines.beaver_en: I heard you recited at camp too?
lines.learner: 네, 밤에 옹기종기 모여 앉아 낭송했어요.
lines.en: Yes, we sat huddled together at night and recited.
lines.roman: ne, bame onggijonggi moyeo anja nangsonghaesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: The atmosphere must have been great.
lines.learner: 별빛 아래라 아름답기가 이를 데 없었어요.
lines.en: Under the starlight, it was beautiful beyond words.
lines.roman: byeolbit araera areumdapgiga ireul de eopseosseoyo.

lines.learner: 윤동주 시인을 좋아해서 시집은 다 읽었어요.
lines.en: I like the poet Yun Dong-ju, so I've read all his collections.
lines.roman: yundongju siineul joahaeseo sijibeun da ilgeosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Don't you get nervous when reciting?
lines.learner: 처음엔 떨려서 실수도 했어요. 지금은 괜찮아요.
lines.en: At first I was nervous and made mistakes. Now I'm fine.
lines.roman: cheoeumen tteollyeoseo silsudo haesseoyo. jigeumeun gwaenchanayo.

lines.beaver_en: What do you usually do on weekends?
lines.learner: 주말엔 동호인들과 시를 쓰고, 함께 낭송해요.
lines.en: On weekends I write poems with club members and recite together.
lines.roman: jumaren donghoindeulgwa sireul sseugo, hamkke nangsonghaeyo.

lines.beaver: 저도 다음 캠프에 같이 가 봐도 될까요?
lines.beaver_en: Could I come along to the next camp?
lines.beaver_roman: jeodo daeum kaempeue gachi ga bwado doelkkayo?
lines.en: Of course. I'll prepare the tent.

lines.beaver: 고마워요. 그때 시집에 사인도 해 주세요.
lines.beaver_en: Thanks. Please sign your poetry collection for me then.
lines.beaver_roman: gomawoyo. geuttae sijibe saindo hae juseyo.
lines.en: Sure. Then I'll see you at camp!
